name: Mammoth Minerals Limited
summary: Mammoth Minerals Limited engages in the acquisition and exploration of resource projects in Australia, Peru, and Canada. It primarily explores for copper, zinc, lithium, gold, silver, lead deposits. The company was formerly known as Firetail Resources Limited and changed its name to Mammoth Minerals Limited in August 2025. Mammoth Minerals Limited was incorporated in 2021 and is based in Claremont, Australia.
